operations.claimBoundary: Arithmetic fidelity, predictive readout and behavioral/causal evidence are different. This operation supplies no behavioral causal test; null draws are comparators, not calibrated p-values. The current batch implementation requires OptVec artifact metadata for layer and dose; other artifact types are not yet accepted.

What observation layers and dose are justified?
